author: Kabiraj Theeng Tamang
review_text: As a student, I rely on eSewa for daily payments and emergencies, but it has become a liability. Transactions frequently get stuck in "Pending" for 24+ hours with no explanation. It leaves me in awkward situations where I can't pay for food or transport. Unlike Khalti, which is much more stable, eSewa crashes often and customer support offers zero clarity on why money is stuck. Don’t use this if you need reliability in urgent situations. Very disappointed in the poor service!
